# Neon

Use `neon/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "neon-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "neon/claude-fable-5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `NEON_AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL`
- `NEON_AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`${NEON_AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `NEON_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://neon.com/docs
